behavior: Check status gives each invoice owner a share of the limit, so one account's invoices can't use it up for everyone
acceptance: Checks of one owner's invoices first take from that owner's own budget; once it is empty, payers of other owners' invoices still get checks.
notes: 2026-10-19 review pass by reviewer: Pass. No blockers. The owner key is the user of the invoice's profile (internal/invoice/recheck.go:72-76), so 10 profiles of one user share one bucket. The per-invoice Postgres limit still runs first. A refusal by either bucket returns before Commit, so the rollback keeps the last check time. An owner refusal returns before the shared bucket is touched, so one owner's extra checks never spend it. An owner token is spent even when the shared bucket then refuses; that is acceptable. The owners map is swept like the other buckets (full buckets dropped once a minute). 3 at once, then one every 5 s per owner per api process, is fine for a manual button. The web pay page is unchanged: a 429 still shows Checked recently and rests 30 s. Minor: 1) TestRecheckLimitsAndChainErrors (internal/httpapi/tests/invoices_recheck_test.go:102-111) now passes on the owner bucket after 3 checks. No test now shows the shared bucket refusing on its own; a test with several owners would cover it. 2) The handler comment at internal/httpapi/invoiceapi/recheck.go:17 still names only the shared budget. 3) The new sentence at docs/backend/api.md:469-470 has 30 words, over the D-84 limit of 25; the new R-55 sentence has about 27. 4) About five free accounts (four for one burst) can still empty the shared bucket. The docs claim only one account, which is right; per-IP and sign-up limits stay at the edge (Q-8). Ran: go test -count=1 -run Recheck on internal/httpapi/tests, internal/invoice and internal/worker: all ok. Ran the new test against the base code in a scratch copy: it fails (one owner's 10 checks at once: none limited). Copy removed. Verify run F254-20261019T201514Z: all 8 checks passed.

proof.1: unit: TestRecheckBudgetHasAShareForEachOwner: one owner's 10 checks at once are limited by the owner's share, and another owner's payer still gets 200 (none limited and the other payer 429 before the fix); existing recheck tests pass
